title: Tech Note: Creating and Using Contextual Help Files

historical_commentary.text: This note describes building an HTML-based online help system within a 4D v6.5 database, leveraging 4D's emerging web capabilities to display documentation. The approach of embedding HTML help was creative for 1999 but has been entirely superseded by modern 4D's built-in help systems, web areas, and standard documentation frameworks. The underlying concept of using HTML for in-app help remains universally valid.
related_updates: 4D's Web Area object replaced ad-hoc HTML display approaches
Modern 4D applications use external documentation sites or integrated help rather than hand-rolled HTML help systems
